follow-up time: Through hospitalization and follow-up to confirm return to normal menses and fertility
cohort: 76 patients with major placenta previa (placenta previa with at least one additional risk factor for bleeding)
finding: Prophylactic intraoperative uterine artery embolization in patients with major placenta previa was associated with reduced intraoperative blood loss but not a significant difference in the need for blood transfusions.
